core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rashed is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Rightly guided”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rashed corresponds to the Arabic form رَاشِد (Arabic root ر ش د (r-sh-d); رَاشِد (Rāshid)). Its core sense is rashed; rightly guided. Rashed is a spelling variant of Arabic رَاشِد (Rāshid) 'rightly guided', from the root ر ش د (r-sh-d). The source gloss 'Righteous Guide' is broadly consistent. Same name as rashid.

persian.name: راشد
persian.long_meaning: Rashed (راشد) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن راشد، هدایت‌یافته است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: राशिद

pashto.name: راشد

arabic.name: رَاشِد
